contracts: 0x001B4896 is selected by state 0x03 and state 0x07 and loads the common base plus the E000 pair-A graphics, publishing the pair-A band-2 palette.
0x001B48C4 is selected by state 0x00 and loads the common base plus SCENE_STATE00_E000_GRAPHICS, publishing the pair-B band-2 palette.
0x001B48F2 is selected by state 0x0A and loads the shared base plus SCENE_SHARED_GRAPHICS_RESOURCE, publishing the C000-variant band-2 palette.
0x001B496C is selected by state 0x01 and loads the common base while publishing the shared scene palette source.
limitations: The pair-A graphics payload is shared by two dispatch states, so its higher-level state-specific asset role remains intentionally unresolved.
These promotions identify exact loader contracts and caller states; they do not claim that every dispatch state has been reached by a natural runtime route.
The legacy palette-address names remain aliases for historical findings and downstream references.
conclusion: Four compact scene-resource variant loaders now have stable identities based on their exact transfer, palette-publication, and dispatch-state contracts.
